column1: # The closed vocabularies of the guarantee rows and the certificate. Sections, by first column:
#   clause  every clause id of CONTRACT.md, in its order, extracted by check/guarantees.py (`clauses`), never retyped;
#   method  how a row is checked: the canonical token; check/guarantees.py maps the rows' phrases onto these (its alias table);
#   status  what a row's strongest method establishes; check/certify.py derives it (`status_of`).
# check/guarantees.py refuses a checked_by token outside the method tokens and the aliases; check/certify.py refuses a clause or status outside this file.
